app.//: Absolute path to the built LabAssistant.exe to drive. Leave empty to auto-locate the newest Debug build under the repo.

discoverExisting.//: In discover-existing mode the harness borrows whatever the app already has. These optional hints let you force a specific choice; empty = auto-pick the first suitable one.

dedicated.//: Reserved for the future dedicated-sandbox mode. Point these at git-ignored fixtures on disk.
